## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check:recipes` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Every command is checked against the official sources listed in the recipe
- [ ] Each OS in `os:` has a working command, or the recipe says why a step doesn't apply
- [ ] Destructive commands (`rm`, `kill -9`, `-wipe-data`, …) have a warning
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, internal hostnames or personal data
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing recipe
- [ ] Category is from `src/data/categories.json`

Maintainer sets `verified:` to the date they checked the commands.
